description:
A new wizard has arrived!
Join her and her magical cats in Bubble Wizard 3 Saga as they battle dark forces in a spellbinding bubble-popping adventure!

Match, shoot, and blast your way through 200 magical levels filled with enchantment, tricky puzzles, and powerful boosters.
Earn daily rewards, rise through the online leaderboards**, and play your way using Joy-Con™, Pro Controller, or touch screen.

Ready to save the realm again? Let the magic begin!

Key Features:
★ 200 handcrafted levels*
★ Boosters & potions to aid your journey
★ Daily rewards and coin drops
★ Supports Joy-Con™, Pro Controller, and touch
★ Enchanting visuals & sound
★ Online leaderboards (optional)**

* First 35 levels are unlocked tutorial stages.
** Players can opt out of leader board.
name: Bubble Wizard III Saga
intro: Match, shoot, and blast through magical levels!
